name: web-cute-monster-404-error-page
title: Fuzzy Monster 404 Page
whatItIs: A rounded-frame website 404 page in warm beige with a huge pale '404' whose middle zero is replaced by a fluffy green one-eyed monster looking sad, with a small brown message beneath.
whatItMeans: A dead end becomes charming. The mascot's sad face softens the frustration, and the tonal beige palette keeps the page soothing.
techniques: Replace a digit with a character so the number and mascot fuse
Render the big numerals in a tone just off the background so they recede
Use a hand-feeling display font for the message and small neutral type for detail
Frame the whole page in a rounded inset border for a card-like feeling
Give the mascot a facial expression that matches the message

vocabulary.definition: Large characters shown in a color close to the background so they act as texture.
Swapping a letter or digit for an illustrated character.
A rounded border set inside the canvas that contains the layout.
